note: Every host-side guard this round adds is in Python (tensor_cuda/tensor_cuda/apa_packed.py, apa_sp2.py); no C++ guard was added (bindings.cpp, packed_launcher.cuh and tensor.cuh are unchanged). Baseline = Build A with e2fb85a1's Python. Evidence: CPU tests (tensor_cuda/tests/test_apa_p1d_policy.py) and L2 on the device (gpu/L2/RESULT.json).

guards.boundary: argument: exactly 'packed' or 'dense' (type str); env TC_APA_SP_STORAGE: exactly 'packed' or 'dense' when set (empty string refused)
guards.baseline: quantize_sp2_keys had no storage argument (TypeError for storage=...) and read no environment variable

guards.boundary: bulk_bits == 4; rank 4; D in {64,128}; dtype float32; device string starts with 'cuda'; packed backend present (TC_APA_PACKED build)
guards.refusal: default: dense with the reason recorded; explicit storage='packed': ValueError
guards.evidence: CPU test_default_two_bit_*, test_explicit_packed_*, test_missing_packed_backend_*, test_cpu_tensor_*; L2 RB_*

guards.boundary: rank 4, float32, D in {64,128}; CUDA device (ordinal parsed from 'cuda[:n]'); capacity int >= S and >= 1
guards.baseline: ApaSpq1Workspace: D64/D128 and capacity >= S only (no dtype/device check)

guards.boundary: append generation current; rank 4; dtype equal; device ordinal equal; (B, KV, D) equal; visible_rows <= S <= capacity; S == visible_rows only for the same source object and revision
guards.baseline: ApaSpq1Workspace.append: (B,H,D), dtype and visible <= S <= capacity; no device ordinal, no source identity

guards.boundary: bound generation == generation; k is the bound source (weak reference); k.revision equal to the revision at binding; rank 4, dtype, device ordinal, (B, KV, D) equal; k.shape[2] == visible_rows
guards.baseline: _apa_spq1_entry checked only fmt and valid_rows == k.shape[2] for a workspace; a raw tuple had no check
guards.evidence: CPU test_stale_generation_is_refused, test_in_place_edit_*, test_append_*; L2 RD_k_not_exact_source, RD_stale_generation, RD_exact_k_edited_in_place, RD_visible_rows_mismatch

guards.boundary: TC_APA_SP == '1'; margins is PackedRegisteredMargins (a dense RegisteredMargins is refused by name); q rank 4; bulk_bits int equal to the object's (4); check_source; q, v and sinks device ordinal == object's; lookup: bits 4, D in {64,128}, dtype float32, float32(scale) == float32(1/sqrt(D)); derive_delta: epsilon in (0,1], e_q finite >= 0, margin <= FLT_MAX; L == 1 (L > 1 refused per R-E)
guards.refusal: RuntimeError (TC_APA_SP, same message as the dense route) or ValueError, before any launch (L2 counts zero device calls)
guards.baseline: the dense route accepted only Tensor kq; the raw packed entry validated devices natively after launching the query rotation
guards.evidence: CPU test_packed_route_refusals_before_launch, test_dense_table_on_packed_*, test_prefill_*; L2 RD_*, RE_*

guards.boundary: a PackedRegisteredMargins with a dense kq
guards.refusal: ValueError ('packed margin table with dense Kq')
guards.baseline: not applicable (no packed table existed); the dense branch body (_dense_sp) is byte-identical to the old function body

guards.boundary: a PackedSpKeys passed where a Tensor is required
guards.refusal: TypeError from the pybind11 signature (unchanged code)
guards.baseline: same pybind11 behaviour for any non-Tensor

not_guarded_here: multi-GPU device switching and stream guards for packing/rotation/append (design (c): later round; single legacy default stream)

the append-only contract that rows below visible_rows are unchanged when a new K object is appended (the caller's contract, as for ApaSpq1Workspace); in-place edits of the bound K are caught by the storage revision
